title: Reachability under equal endpoint data
statement: Fix a natural parameter $K_0$, an oracle, a Boolean string $x$, and natural numbers $B,P$. If a configuration $a$ reaches the configuration with label $l$, register state $st$, memory $M$, and head position $p$, with the guard holding at every time strictly before arrival, then whenever $st=st'$ and $p=p'$, $a$ also reaches the configuration with label $l$, register state $st'$, memory $M$, and head position $p'$, with the same guard condition.
hypotheses_covered: guarded reachability from $a$ to the configuration with label $l$, state $st$, memory $M$, and head position $p$
replaced:
If a configuration $a$ reaches the configuration with label $l$, register state $st$,
memory $M$, and head position $p$, then, whenever $st=st'$ and $p=p'$, the same initial
configuration $a$ reaches the configuration with label $l$, state $st'$, memory $M$, and
head position $p'$. The reachability condition requires the guard to hold at every
intermediate time before arrival.
